1  loopWidth = gTileIDList.count * 128  loopX = gTileIDList.count * 128 * 0.5  Xpos = float(this.locH)  Ypos = float(this.locV)  this.locZ = sprite(the currentSpriteNum - 1).locZ - 1  Xvel = 0  mapXPos = Xpos - 256 - 64  survivorDelay = 0  swellAngle = 0  cableGuy = sprite(6)  survivorState = #ONGROUND  ThisWidth = this.width  thisHalfHeight = this.height / 2  grabCount = 0  distToHQ = 0  frameDir = 1endon exitFrame  if gPaused = 0 then    case survivorState of      #ONGROUND:        if targetSprite = this.spriteNum then          Xpos = Xpos + (gXVel + gXOffset)          this.locH = Xpos          if Xpos > loopX then            Xpos = Xpos - loopWidth          end if          if Xpos < -loopX then            Xpos = Xpos + loopWidth          end if        else          this.loc = sprite(targetSprite).loc + targetOffset        end if        survivorDelay = survivorDelay + 1        if survivorDelay >= 5 then          survivorDelay = 0        end if        diffX = abs(this.locH - cableGuy.locH)        diffY = abs(this.locV - cableGuy.locV)        if (diffX < ThisWidth) and (diffY < thisHalfHeight) then          grabCount = grabCount + 1          if (grabCount >= 2) and (sprite(targetSprite).attackMode = #FLEE) then            if (gCableItem = 0) and (gCableLength >= 50) then              survivorState = #ONCABLE              sprite(targetSprite).attackMode = #PILOTLESS              puppetSound(2, member(97, "Sfx"))              gCableItem = 1            end if          end if        else          grabCount = 0        end if      #ONCABLE:        this.loc = cableGuy.loc        if gCableLength = 0 then          gCableItem = 0          survivorState = #INCOPTER          gRescueCount = gRescueCount + 1          gScore = gScore + 500          puppetSound(3, member(8, "Sfx"))        end if      #INCOPTER:        this.locH = -1000        this.locV = -1000    end case  end ifend
